title: CLI UX/UI Implementation Plan v2

observations: Colorized output exists in many commands via chalk.
Interactive mode exists in Application with inquirer menus.
Table rendering is present in Status command via cli-table3.
ASCII banner is present via figlet.
JSON mode exists but formatting contracts differ by command.

package_usage_detected_in_src.ora: dependency present, not currently imported in src
package_usage_detected_in_src.boxen: dependency present, not currently imported in src
package_usage_detected_in_src.blessed: dependency present, not currently imported in src

ux_gaps: No shared renderer contract for text outputs across commands.
No universal progress pattern for long-running operations.
No consistent success/error/receipt presentation in human mode.
No clear startup journey tied to top workflows (workspace/identity/commerce).
Some logger behavior routes to stderr globally, which can pollute command UX.

design_principles: Text-first UX with strict JSON parity.
Deterministic machine output, expressive human output.
One output grammar across all namespaces.
Progressive disclosure: concise by default, detail on demand.
Errors must be actionable in one rerun.

rules: Stable top-level shape per envelope type

progress.transport: stdout in human mode, structured events in json mode

no_args_behavior.target: show quick action hub with top workflows
